resolved_descriptor_wrapper.behavior: validates/caches an already-resolved descriptor and calls F8AFD0(stage=1,slot,count=1)

resource_handle_wrapper.behavior: resolves a D1 resource handle to its GPU texture descriptor, validates/caches it, and calls F8AFD0(stage=1,slot,count=1)

group_array_behavior: loads mesh-group count from owning terrain record
uses selected group index as index*0x60
t14_branch: if dword[group + 0x58] == 0xFFFFFFFF: call 0x7DF310(..., slot=0xE, descriptor=null) to clear T14
otherwise: call 0x7DF250(..., slot=0xE, resource_handle=dword[group + 0x58]) to resolve and bind T14
direct_terrain_producer.conclusion: Retail executable directly binds the selected SMeshGroup Dyemap field to PS T14. This is a native producer edge, not correlation, exporter naming, or a later-D2 convention.

terrain_ps_census.note: Previously established T14 externality and exhaustive association with effective STerrain dyemaps; no longer needed as the producer proof itself.

ps_texture_setter_trace.note: Both literal slot-14 writes are the clear/bind branches in 0x8B3980.

caller_decompile.note: Ghidra confirms 0x8B3980 group-array traversal and 0x105ABC0 caller.

supersedes_proof_boundary.now_closed: exact retail writer/source edge SMeshGroup.dyemap_hash -> PS T14

implementation.architecture: D1 importer owns T14 resolution per (material,effective_dyemap) terrain binding; generic renderer receives ordinary neutral texture bindings and remains Destiny-agnostic.
implementation.important_ownership: T14 is per SMeshGroup/draw, not per serialized material. SurfacePrograms may deduplicate while ProgramBindings vary by effective dyemap.

non_claims: The D1 exporter-side GroupIndex/15 vertex-color helper remains an exporter helper and is not promoted as a native GPU dyemap source.
This evidence does not assign unrelated resource-table slots or later-D2 terrain semantics to D1.
